results.title: Senior Manager - Blockchain & Digital Assets Lead, Technology Risk (Financial Services Assurance)
results.description:
At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together

We’re all in, are you?

Join EY and shape your future with confidence.

The opportunity

Digital assets is moving from the edge of financial services towards its core. Singapore has one of the most complete regulatory frameworks for digital asset activity anywhere in the world – the Payment Services Act 2019 for digital payment token services, the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022 regime for digital token service providers, consumer-protection and custody safeguards, technology risk and cyber hygiene notices, and a framework for single-currency stablecoins – while banks and asset managers are tokenizing funds, deposits and securities through initiatives such as Project Guardian. Exchanges, custodians, digital asset fund managers, stablecoin issuers, banks and fintechs across Singapore and ASEAN need assurance that their technology, controls and reporting will stand up to auditors, regulators and institutional counterparties.

Our Blockchain & Digital Assets team sits with EY's Technology & Cyber Risk Practice for Financial Services in Singapore and works alongside our financial audit, cybersecurity, financial crime, tax, consulting and transactions teams to give clients one integrated view of technology risk, financial services and regulatory compliance. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and grow this practice: the recognized subject matter leader for blockchain and digital assets in the Singapore firm, accountable for the quality of our technical work, the growth of our client portfolio and the development of our specialists.

You will work directly with the Partner leading Technology & Cyber Risk, with audit engagement partners across the global firm, and with senior client stakeholders including CTOs, CISOs, CFOs, CROs, Business Heads, Boards and Audit Committees. This is a client-facing leadership role with a clear mandate – and the support of a globally connected EY blockchain specialist team – to shape what a leading digital asset practice looks like in this region.

Your key responsibilities

Practice leadership and growth

  • Lead and grow the practice. Set the service strategy for Blockchain & Digital Assets in Singapore with Asia client reach, own the opportunity pipeline, and build a portfolio of digital asset exchanges, custodians, fund managers, stablecoin issuers, banks and fintechs by focusing on high-impact opportunities.

  • Be the firm's subject matter leader. Lead proposals and oral presentations for medium- to high-complexity engagements, bring technical insight to pursuits across Assurance, Consulting, Tax and Strategy and Transactions, and act as the go-to resource for audit teams and other service lines on digital asset matters.

  • Build trusted senior relationships. Advise C-suite and senior stakeholders, translating complex technology, accounting and regulatory issues into practical, decision-ready recommendations that shape real business outcomes.

  • Shape the market view. Develop EY points of view, thought leadership and new offerings in areas such as custody assurance, stablecoin reserve attestation, tokenization and DeFi risk; represent EY with regulators, industry bodies and at market events.

Technical delivery and quality

  • Blockchain specialist support for financial statement audits. Lead the design and review of audit procedures over digital asset balances and transactions – existence, ownership, completeness and valuation of on-chain holdings, wallet attribution, on-chain reconciliation to the general ledger.

  • Custody and key-management reviews. Direct assessments of custody technology and infrastructure and controls – MPC, HSM, multi-signature and hot/warm/cold wallet architecture, private key lifecycle and key ceremonies, transaction authorization workflows, segregation of customer assets, reconciliation and governance controls – against MAS requirements and leading practice.

  • Token, protocol and smart contract assessments. Oversee technical research and evaluations of tokens and blockchain networks – consensus mechanisms, tokenomics, governance, degree of decentralization, staking and DeFi protocols, bridges and Layer 2 networks – and smart contract reviews, ensuring conclusions are well supported, consistently documented and defensible.

  • Regulatory assurance and licensing readiness. Lead reviews and readiness engagements for licensed and prospective entities under the Payment Services Act (digital payment token services) and the FSMA 2022 digital token service provider regime, covering digital payment tokens, technology risk management, cyber hygiene, AML/CFT and Travel Rule controls, consumer-protection safeguards and, as the framework develops, single-currency stablecoin requirements.

  • Attestation and controls reporting. Deliver independent assurance reports – SSAE/ISAE 3000, SOC 1 and SOC 2, proof-of-reserves and agreed-upon procedures related to digital assets – for exchanges, custodians and issuers whose institutional counterparties require independent assurance.

  • Own engagement economics, quality and risk. Plan and manage scope, budgets, timelines, staffing and deliverables across a portfolio of concurrent engagements, applying EY quality, independence and risk management standards throughout.

People and firm

  • Build and lead the team. Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing team of blockchain and technology risk specialists; set technical standards and run training and knowledge-sharing on digital asset topics across Assurance and other service lines.

  • Develop our people. Act as a counsellor and role model, conduct performance reviews and provide feedback, and contribute to recruiting, retention and learning initiatives.

  • Bring the whole of EY to clients. Collaborate closely with Technology Risk, Financial Audit, Cybersecurity, Financial Crime, Tax and Consulting colleagues, and with EY's global blockchain network, to deliver integrated solutions and identify new digital asset opportunities.


Skills and attributes for success

  • Deep blockchain and digital asset knowledge. Bitcoin, Ethereum and other Layer 1 networks, architecture, the EVM, ERC token standards and EIPs, consensus mechanisms, Layer 2 networks, staking, DeFi protocols and cross-chain bridges – with the ability to assess an unfamiliar protocol from first principles.

  • Hands-on understanding of custody technology. MPC, HSMs, multi-signature schemes, cold storage, wallet segregation, transaction policy engines and key ceremonies, and the operational controls that surround them.

  • Command of the Singapore regulatory framework. The Payment Services Act, the FSMA 2022 digital token service provider regime, MAS technology risk management and cyber hygiene notices, AML/CFT and Travel Rule requirements, consumer-protection safeguards and the single-currency stablecoin framework – and a working view of how regimes across ASEAN and major markets compare.

  • Assurance experience. Familiar with gathering audit evidence over on-chain balances and transactions for digital assets, controls assurance standards (SSAE/ISAE 3000, SOC) and the quality and independence requirements of a global audit firm.

  • A confident communicator. Able to distil technical and regulatory complexity into clear language for boards, audit committees and regulators – and to hold your own in a room of engineers.

  • Commercial judgement and a builder's mindset. The ability to spot high-impact opportunities, shape and price offerings, and grow a practice while protecting quality.


To qualify for the role, you must have

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in financial services, fintech or professional services, with a substantial focus on technology risk, IT audit, assurance or compliance for blockchain and digital assets.

  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in blockchain and digital assets, including Ethereum ERC standards and EIPs, staking and DeFi protocols, and the evaluation of tokens and blockchain networks.

  • Practical understanding of digital asset custody technologies and private key management controls.

  • Working knowledge of Singapore's regulatory requirements for digital asset activities, including the Payment Services Act, the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022 and the relevant MAS notices and guidelines.

  • A track record of leading client engagements and teams, managing engagement budgets and quality, and contributing to business development in a professional services or comparable environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English.

Ideally, you'll also have

  • A professional qualification such as CISA, CISSP, or CRISC, or a recognized blockchain or security credential; a master's degree is an advantage.

  • Experience in a Big Four or comparable professional services environment, including performing or reviewing financial statement audit procedures over digital assets, or delivering SOC, ISAE 3000 or proof-of-reserves engagements.

  • Familiarity with smart contract security review, on-chain analytics and blockchain forensic tools (for example Chainalysis, Elliptic or TRM Labs) and with reconciliation and accounting tools.

  • Exposure to tokenization initiatives such as Project Guardian, tokenized funds and deposits, or stablecoin issuance and reserve management.

  • Knowledge of digital asset regulatory regimes in other ASEAN and major markets (for example Hong Kong SFC, Securities Commission Malaysia, Thailand SEC, Indonesia OJK or EU MiCA) and of international standards from the FATF, IOSCO and the Basel Committee.

  • A profile in the digital asset community through publications, speaking engagements, industry working groups or open-source contributions.


EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

results.title: Senior Blockchain Engineer
results.description:
Why Join

We are seeking a Senior Blockchain Engineer to join OCBC’semerging technology team. The role focuses on building secure, scalable,resilient and compliant digital asset, and blockchain-enabled financial solutions.

The role also requires an understanding of solution architecture and financial domain design, including the ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into secure and scalable blockchain architectures for digital assets in banking.


How you succeed

The successful candidate will have strong engineering hands-on experience in blockchain protocols, smart contracts, distributed systems, and enterprise-grade application development. You will work closely with business analysts, architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity and other engineering teams to design and deliver digital asset and blockchain solutions suitable for a regulated banking environment.

This role is ideal for an engineer who understands both modern Web3 technologies and the standards required in financial institutions, including security, resilience, auditability, regulatory compliance, and production-grade operational controls

What you do

Understand and design around digital asset lifecycles, including transaction processing, custody, tokenization, settlement, and reconciliation, ensuring alignment with banking workflows and controls.

Translate business and regulatory requirements into secure, scalable architectures, covering on-chain and off-chain integration, data consistency, and end-to-end transaction flows across blockchain and enterprise systems.

Design, develop, test, and deploy blockchain applications, APIs, and services, ensuring clean code, secure development practices, and alignment with architecture standards

Build and operate systems with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, containerisation, and cloud-native platforms, ensuring resilience, scalability, and production readiness

Monitor and optimise production systems using metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards; manage incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and deliver hot-fixes aligned with SLA, stability, and compliance requirements.

Who you are

Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

At least 5 years of software engineering experience, including significant backend development experience.

At least 3 years of hands-on blockchain or distributed ledger technology experience.

Strong in TypeScript/Node.js, Java, Solidity; experience building APIs, microservices, and secure systems.

Understanding of digital asset lifecycle (custody, wallets, tokenization, settlement, reconciliation) and blockchain fundamentals.

Experience with distributed system design andon-chain/off-chain architectures, including data consistency and integration patterns.

Familiar with CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and operating production systems with observability and SLAs

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a bank, fintech, capital markets firm, payments company, or regulated financial institution.

Experience working in asset tokenisation, tokenised deposits, stablecoins, CBDCs, purpose-bound money, payments, settlements, custody and related.

Knowledge of Singapore financial services regulations, technology risk expectations, or MAS-aligned control environments.

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Knowledge of smart contract security, formal verification, or audit processes.

Knowledge of confidential and privacy technologies, e.g., Zero Knowledge Proofs, Verifiable Credentials, Zero Trust Architecture etc

Understanding of ISO 20022, payments infrastructure, securities settlement, or treasury operations would be advantageous.

Key Competencies

Strong engineering discipline and attention to detail.

Ability to operate effectively in a regulated banking environment.

Practical understanding of risk, security, compliance, and operational resilience.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to simplify complex technical concepts.

Comfortable working with cross-functional teams including business, legal, compliance, cybersecurity, and infrastructure.

Ability to balance innovation with production stability and regulatory expectations.

Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver independently.

Who we are
As Singapore's longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we're on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation.
But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia's leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career. Your Opportunity Starts Here.

results.title: Senior Blockchain Engineering
results.description:
The Mission

Arukah Capital is scaling the next gigaton of carbon removal by integrating industrial biochar and biogas production into global agrifood supply chains with tamper proof digital infrastructure and high frequency remote monitoring. We are seeking a Head of Blockchain Engineering and/or a Senior Blockchain Engineer. You will be responsible for architecting the blockchain infrastructure for Attest —our proprietary dMRV (Digital Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) architecture with institutional carbon markets.

Core Responsibilities

  • Smart Contract Architecture: Develop and maintain the smart contract suite for Project Attest.

  • High-Integrity Tokenization: Architect the lifecycle of "Investment Grade" credits—from initial sequestration data ingestion to permanent retirement—ensuring compliance with leading registry methodologies, including Puro.earth and Gold Standard.

  • Programmable Revenue Distribution: Implement the logic for Arukah’s signature 50% gross carbon revenue allocation. You will build the rails that ensure transparent, auditable disbursement to participating smallholder farmers and agricultural partners.

  • Registry-Native Integration: Build secure adapters and relayers that synchronize on-chain state with global carbon registries and Singapore’s Article 6-aligned trading hubs.

Technical Requirements

  • Smart Contracts: Expert proficiency in Solidity (EVM) with a focus on ERC-721 and ERC-1155 standards, or equivalent. Experience with upgradeable contract patterns (UUPS/Transparent) for long-term project durability.

  • Data Pipelines: Experience handling off-chain data ingestion (from KMS-signed IoT payloads or AI inference results) and verifying it on-chain via Oracle logic or Merkle Proofs.

  • Security & Audit: A "security-first" mindset. You have successfully led contracts through Tier-1 audits and understand the nuances of role-based access control (RBAC) in institutional finance.

  • Backend & Infrastructure: Strong command of Node.js/TypeScript. Experience with PostgreSQL.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with the CosmWasm/Provenance ecosystem or Polygon CDK, reflecting Arukah’s multi-chain approach to RWA infrastructure.

Why Arukah?

If you believe that high-integrity climate transition requires both advanced engineering and poverty alleviation, we want to hear from you.

postedCompany.description:
Arukah (noun): To Heal, To Restore ~

At its core, Arukah is committed to healing—both the planet and the communities that sustain it. We combine proven technology with an equitable business model to restore balance to the land of agriculture and carbon markets.

Arukah is driving gigaton-scale impact in the Global South by harnessing the power of high-integrity carbon projects that transform waste biomass into clean energy - Biogas - and mature carbon removal solutions - Biochar.


We want to set a new industry benchmark by sharing 50% of gross carbon credit revenues directly with smallholder farmers, and ensuring that all project data is tracked in real time. As a homegrown project developer, we are proud to have opened Southeast Asia’s largest biochar plant, and achieved formal digital MRV integration with global registries for best in class transparency and risk management.

results.title: Senior Software Engineer (Rust)
results.description:
Team: Engineering
Reports to: Tech Lead
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

Nodeworthy is supporting a Web3 technology company that helps blockchain projects execute large-scale token-distribution and ecosystem-growth campaigns.

The company builds and operates digital-asset infrastructure for its clients. Projects are delivered through short, parallel engagement cycles involving firm deadlines and real commercial consequences. Its systems must therefore remain accurate, responsive and reliable under heavy workloads.

The team is also conducting research and development for a new blockchain intelligence and data product.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own the company’s backend services throughout their lifecycle—from architecture and implementation to deployment and operation in production.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor position. It does not involve people management, sales or product design. The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable working autonomously and willing to take full ownership of complex technical problems.

What You’ll Own

Backend Services

  • Design, build and operate production backend services primarily in Rust.
  • Make architectural decisions that balance performance, reliability and maintainability.
  • Monitor services and resolve issues throughout their production lifecycle.

On-Chain Data Infrastructure

  • Develop indexers and event-processing pipelines for blockchain data.
  • Ensure internal data remains consistent with upstream blockchain states.
  • Design systems that handle retries, duplicate events, partial failures and blockchain reorganisations correctly.

APIs and Data Services

  • Build and maintain the APIs powering internal tools and client-facing dashboards.
  • Design reliable interfaces for accessing and processing large volumes of on-chain data.
  • Maintain clear and well-structured data models.

Data Accuracy

  • Take ownership of the accuracy and consistency of figures generated by your services.
  • Investigate discrepancies and explain how reported figures were derived.
  • Implement appropriate validation, reconciliation and monitoring processes.

Production Releases

  • Support client launches, production deployments and short-notice releases.
  • Diagnose and resolve live production issues under time pressure.
  • Create runbooks and improve operational processes following incidents.

Smart Contract Integration

  • Build services that interact with smart contracts across supported blockchain networks.
  • Work alongside smart-contract engineers and support contract deployment and maintenance when required.

Job requirements

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

  • Strong production experience with Rust, particularly asynchronous services, APIs and data-ingestion systems. This is the primary technology stack and the most important requirement.
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems, concurrency, data modelling and SQL.
  • Experience building data-intensive or high-throughput systems where correctness is critical.
  • Understanding of blockchain fundamentals, including EVM and/or Solana, RPC providers, event logs and indexers.
  • Familiarity with smart contracts, including Rust-based development frameworks such as Anchor.
  • Ability to diagnose production systems and make sound decisions under time pressure.
  • Clear written English and the ability to produce runbooks and technical documentation.
  • A proactive and accountable working style, with the ability to operate independently in a distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in digital assets, trading, DeFi or financial infrastructure.
  • Exposure to multiple blockchain ecosystems or cross-chain infrastructure.
  • Experience building or operating blockchain indexing infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting time-sensitive client or production launches.

What This Role Does Not Cover

  • People management or formal team leadership.
  • Business development or client acquisition.
  • Product design or marketing responsibilities.

Interview Process

1. Rust Technical Deep Dive

You will discuss a production service you have built, including:

  • Its architecture and data model.
  • How it handled failures and retries.
  • How you verified the accuracy of its output.
  • The technical trade-offs you made.

2. Practical Exercise

You will complete a focused Rust implementation exercise together with a data-processing problem.

3. Production Judgement

You will be presented with a scenario involving a live service reporting incorrect figures and asked to explain what you would investigate, in what order and why.

4. Technical Communication

You will be asked to share or discuss a runbook, technical document or engineering write-up you have authored.

Application

This is a confidential search managed by Nodeworthy.

To apply, please submit:

  • Your CV.
  • GitHub profile or technical portfolio.
  • A short description of a production Rust service you have built.
  • Any relevant blockchain, indexing or data-infrastructure projects.

Shortlisted candidates will receive further details about the company and opportunity directly from Nodeworthy.


Grab the chance and don't lose it. Apply now!
https://nodeworthy.recruitee.com/o/senior-software-engineer-rust
